_comment: Domains and data elements of the operations framework. The area of a run, finding, alert rule, lock and purge target is ZCA_PARAM_AREA_ID of the parameter framework (one area register); the other fields use built-in types and SAP data elements, except the status of a control (2026-11-10: fixed values with translatable texts, shown by the review app and the consumers' cards) and the status of a planned downtime window (2026-11-11, downtime app ZUI_CA_OPS_DTW) and the reason a control sign-off was reopened (2026-11-11, explainable, versioned results) and the control tag, evaluation status, reserved rows and account roles of the account flow dashboard (2026-11-15, docs/ACCOUNT_FLOW.md). tools/abapgit_serialize.py writes src/<name>.doma.xml / .dtel.xml for every entry added here. Labels: short <= 10, medium <= 20, long <= 40, heading <= 55, text <= 60 characters.
